description: An introduction to websites, web browsers and servers, and how to build basic web pages using HTML tags, elements, attributes and good web design principles.

options.text: A single picture stored on a computer
A collection of related web pages accessed through the Internet
A program used to print documents
A cable that connects two computers

mcq.explanation: A website is a collection of related web pages, usually identified by a common domain name and accessed over the Internet.

mcq.questionText: Which software is used to view web pages on the Internet?
mcq.explanation: A web browser, such as Google Chrome or Mozilla Firefox, is the software used to request and display web pages.
HTML stands for HyperText Markup Language, the standard language used to create the structure of web pages.

mcq.questionText: A computer that stores web pages and sends them to browsers when requested is called a:
mcq.explanation: A web server is a computer that stores website files and delivers them to browsers that request them.

mcq.questionText: Which tag is used to create the largest heading in HTML?
mcq.explanation: The <h1> tag creates the largest (most important) heading, while <h6> creates the smallest.

mcq.questionText: Which HTML tag is used to create a paragraph?
mcq.explanation:
The

tag defines a paragraph of text in an HTML document.

mcq.questionText: What is the difference between a static and a dynamic web page?

options.text: A static page changes for each user, while a dynamic page never changes
A static page shows the same fixed content to every user, while a dynamic page can change its content
A static page needs the Internet, while a dynamic page does not
There is no difference between them

mcq.explanation: A static web page displays the same fixed content to all visitors, while a dynamic web page can generate different content depending on the user or situation.

mcq.questionText: Which element contains the visible content of a web page that appears in the browser window?
mcq.explanation: The <body> element holds all the visible content, such as text, images and links, that is shown in the browser window.

mcq.questionText: Which attribute of the <a> tag specifies the web address the link points to?
mcq.explanation: The href attribute of the <a> tag specifies the destination URL of a hyperlink.

mcq.questionText: Which tag is used to insert an image into a web page?
mcq.explanation: The tag inserts an image, and its src attribute gives the file name or location of the image.

mcq.questionText: What does a closing tag look like in HTML?

options.text: It starts with a forward slash after the opening angle bracket, for example
It uses square brackets, for example [p]
It has two opening brackets, for example <
It is written in capital letters only, for example

mcq.explanation:
A closing tag is written with a forward slash before the tag name, such as

, to mark where an element ends.

mcq.questionText: Which pair of tags creates an ordered (numbered) list with its list items?
mcq.explanation: An ordered list uses the <ol> tag, and each item inside it is written with the <li> tag.

mcq.questionText: Which of the following is a good web design principle?

options.text: Using many different fonts and colours on every page
Keeping the design consistent and easy to navigate
Hiding the menu so users cannot find it
Filling pages with as much text as possible

mcq.explanation: Good web design favours consistency, simple layouts and easy navigation so users can find information quickly.

mcq.questionText: Which tag is used to make text bold, giving it strong importance?
mcq.explanation: The <strong> tag (like <b>) makes text bold; <strong> also tells the browser the text has strong importance.

mcq.questionText: What is the main purpose of HTML in building a web page?

options.text: To protect the computer from viruses
To define the structure and content of the page
To connect the computer to electricity
To store data permanently in a database

mcq.explanation: HTML uses tags to define the structure and content of a web page, such as headings, paragraphs, images and links.

fib.questionText: A single document on a website that you view in a browser is called a web _____.
fib.explanation: A web page is a single document of a website; many related web pages together form a website.

fib.questionText: The software used to open and display web pages is called a web _____.
fib.explanation: A web browser, such as Chrome or Firefox, requests web pages and displays them to the user.

fib.questionText: In the tag <a href="home.html">, the word href is an example of an HTML _____.
fib.explanation: An attribute provides extra information about an element; href gives the link destination for the <a> tag.

fib.questionText: The tag used to insert a single line break in HTML is <_____>.
fib.explanation:
The
tag inserts a line break, moving the following text to a new line.

fib.questionText: The element that holds the title shown on the browser tab and other page information that is not displayed in the page body is the <_____> element.
fib.explanation: The <head> element contains information about the page, such as the <title>, which is not shown in the main page area.

fib.questionText: In the image tag , the attribute that gives the image file name is _____.
fib.explanation: The src attribute of the tag specifies the source file or location of the image to display.

fib.questionText: A web page whose content stays the same for every visitor is called a _____ web page.
fib.explanation: A static web page shows fixed content that does not change from one user to another.

fib.questionText: In HTML, each item inside a list is written using the <_____> tag.
fib.explanation: The <li> tag defines a list item inside an ordered (<ol>) or unordered (<ul>) list.

fib.questionText: The very first tag that should enclose a whole HTML document is the <_____> tag.
fib.explanation: The <html> element is the root element that contains all other parts of the HTML document.

fib.questionText: Making a website available on the Internet by placing its files on a web server is called _____ the website.
fib.explanation: Publishing (or hosting) a website means uploading its files to a web server so people can access it online.

tf.questionText: A web browser and a web server are exactly the same thing.
tf.explanation: They are different: a browser requests and displays pages, while a server stores pages and sends them when requested.

tf.questionText: HTML is used to define the structure and content of a web page.
tf.explanation: HTML uses tags to mark up content such as headings, paragraphs, links and images, defining the page structure.

tf.questionText: The <h1> tag produces a smaller heading than the <h6> tag.
tf.explanation: <h1> is the largest heading and <h6> is the smallest, so <h1> is larger, not smaller, than <h6>.

tf.questionText: The content placed inside the <body> element is displayed in the browser window.
tf.explanation: The <body> element contains the visible content of the page, such as text, images and links.

tf.questionText: Most HTML elements need both an opening tag and a closing tag.
tf.explanation:
Many elements, such as

...

, use an opening tag and a closing tag to mark where the element begins and ends.

tf.questionText: The href attribute is used with the tag to set the source of an image.
tf.explanation: The tag uses the src attribute for the image file; href is used with the tag for links.

tf.questionText: A dynamic web page can show different content to different users or at different times.
tf.explanation: Dynamic web pages can change their content depending on the user, time or other conditions.

tf.questionText: The <ul> tag is used to create an unordered (bulleted) list.
tf.explanation: The <ul> tag creates an unordered list, whose items normally appear with bullet points.

tf.questionText: Using a consistent layout and clear navigation across pages is poor web design.
tf.explanation: Consistency and clear navigation are good web design principles because they help users find information easily.

tf.questionText: A simple text editor such as Notepad can be used to write HTML code.
tf.explanation: HTML is plain text, so it can be written in any text editor, including Notepad, as well as in specialised web design tools.

summary.questionText: Define a website in one sentence.
summary.correctAnswer: A website is a collection of related web pages, usually under one domain name, that are accessed through the Internet.
summary.explanation: This captures the key idea that a website groups related pages reachable online.

summary.questionText: Explain the difference between a web browser and a web server.
summary.correctAnswer: A web browser is software that requests and displays web pages, while a web server is a computer that stores web pages and sends them when a browser requests them.
summary.explanation: The browser is on the user side; the server stores and serves the pages.

summary.questionText: What is HTML and what is its role in web design?
summary.correctAnswer: HTML (HyperText Markup Language) is the language used to create web pages; it uses tags to define the structure and content of a page.
summary.explanation: HTML provides the structure and content of pages through tags and elements.

summary.questionText: Describe the basic structure of an HTML document.
summary.correctAnswer: An HTML document starts with the <html> element, which contains a <head> section (with the <title>) and a <body> section that holds the visible content.

summary.questionText: Explain the difference between an HTML tag and an HTML attribute.
summary.correctAnswer:
A tag marks the start or end of an element (such as

), while an attribute provides extra information about an element (such as href in ).
summary.explanation: Tags define elements; attributes add details to those elements.

summary.questionText: What is the difference between a static and a dynamic web page?
summary.correctAnswer: A static web page shows the same fixed content to everyone, while a dynamic web page can change its content depending on the user or situation.
summary.explanation: Static pages are fixed; dynamic pages can vary their content.

summary.questionText: Name three common web design principles.
summary.correctAnswer: Consistency, easy navigation and simplicity (and accessibility) are common web design principles.
summary.explanation: Good design keeps pages consistent, simple, easy to navigate and accessible.

summary.questionText: What is the purpose of the <a> tag and its href attribute?
summary.correctAnswer: The <a> tag creates a hyperlink, and its href attribute gives the web address or file the link points to.
summary.explanation: <a href="..."> turns text or images into clickable links to other pages.

summary.questionText: List two tools that can be used to create web pages.
summary.correctAnswer: A plain text editor such as Notepad and a web design program such as a code editor or visual web editor can be used to create web pages.
summary.explanation: HTML can be typed in a simple text editor or built using dedicated web design tools.

summary.questionText: Briefly explain what it means to publish a website.
summary.correctAnswer: Publishing a website means uploading its files to a web server so that people can access the site over the Internet.
summary.explanation: Hosting/publishing places the site on a server where users can reach it online.

hoq.questionText:
Study the HTML code below:
  • Maths
  • Physics
  • Biology
When this code is opened in a browser, how will the three subjects appear?

options.text: As a numbered list: 1. Maths 2. Physics 3. Biology
As a bulleted (unordered) list of the three subjects
As a table with three columns
As one paragraph with the words joined together

hoq.explanation: The <ul> tag creates an unordered list, so the three <li> items appear as bullet points, not numbers.

hoq.questionText: Look at this HTML code: Contact Us What will a user see and what happens when it is clicked?

options.text: The user sees the text contact.html and clicking shows Contact Us
The user sees an image named contact and clicking does nothing
The user sees the clickable text Contact Us and clicking opens the page contact.html
The user sees a table called Contact Us

hoq.explanation: The visible text is Contact Us, and the href attribute makes the link open contact.html when clicked.

hoq.questionText:
Consider the HTML below:
Name Age
What does the tag represent in this table?

options.text: A single row of the table
A single column of the table

hoq.explanation: The <tr> tag defines a table row, and the <td> tags inside it define the data cells in that row.
